references.scope: functional reference only: request/status shape (id, request.message/subject/sns_topic_arn/message_structure); no Lambda, IoT Core status routing or recipe compatibility

Subject under 100 characters, json MessageStructure with string default, MessageAttributes, FIFO MessageGroupId/MessageDeduplicationId, 256 KiB default size, MessageId/SequenceNumber, documented errors
attribute names, String/Number/String.Array/Binary types, attributes only with string structure

source: durable QoS 1 SF-032 pub/sub subscription; sender is the SO_PEERCRED-authenticated component
status: local pub/sub status_topic, at least once, correlated by request id
grants: exact sender component to exact same-Region topic ARN; checked before any other request processing or network I/O
retry: per-request durable attempt bound 1..100; foreground backoff 1..60 s; local token bucket rate limit
duplicates: standard topics at least once after ambiguous responses; FIFO topics get a stable derived MessageDeduplicationId
live_aws: unrun; separate authorization required; tracked in SF-078/#132
license: clean-room original implementation; no AWS component code copied
